move: three glowing gradient shapes cycle circle, square, triangle, hexagon while spinning
how: Three SVG paths filled with linear gradients sit at thirds of the width, each with a blurred (feGaussianBlur 18) glow copy behind at 55% opacity. Every D/4 each shape morphSVGs to the next form in the ring circle, square, triangle, hexagon over 0.75s (expo.inOut) from a different starting form so the fourth morph lands on its first; all rotate 360 over D (ease none) and the main shapes pulse scale 1 to 1.12 on a sine yoyo eight times per loop.
adapt: Change the three gradient pairs, the radius R, the caption and the forms list; keep the ring walk so each shape returns to its start after N morphs.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the SVG with unique gradient and filter ids; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with step = D/N. Scope '#sa'..'#sc2' to el.
caveats: SVG feGaussianBlur on three glow copies re-rasterises every frame
gradient and filter ids are document-level
